meta.title: Phone approval and notifications
meta.description: Pushes a notification to your iPhone through Bark when an agent asks for approval, asks you a question, finishes a turn, or fails. Approval notifications carry a one-time link: reject on the phone, or allow with Face ID (passkey); whichever of phone and desktop answers first wins, and a phone answer withdraws the desktop prompt. Open Phone approval in the left sidebar to store the Bark key, send a test notification, check Tailscale and Face ID, and adjust options. The phone page is published only to your tailnet through tailscale serve; links are single-use and expire after 10 minutes by default. Tool names, approval reasons, questions, and answer previews pass through the Bark server (api.day.app by default); commands are shown only on the phone approval page. Turning the plugin off stops notifications and phone approval.
